title: Resumable module publication with artifact identity checks
summary: Phase-based cluster publication validates release inputs, persists recovery state and requires propagation and packaged acceptance evidence.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Developed resumable module-publication automation spanning archive inspection, cross-site transfer, LSF execution, package construction, publication, propagation and packaged acceptance.
Persisted phase state, attempts, results and failures, reusing completed phases on resume while rejecting changes that violate release identity.
Built release validators checking safe archive members/link targets, required payloads, Python requirements, offline dependency provenance, clean source identity and capability-manifest hashes.
Preserved payload bytes and modes after validation and extraction under restrictive batch umasks, and isolated acceptance from pre-existing MCP registrations.
The snapshot records 57 publication test definitions, compared with 46 at the inspected HEAD; the analysis did not execute these tests or publish modules.

notes: Do not claim every proposed publication/acceptance lane ran. Mechanism implementation and live publication outcomes are separate evidence categories.
